_comment: Baseline for scripts/check-migration-integrity.mjs. An entry means READ AND CLASSIFIED,
never 'exempt'. It only shrinks. Every entry carries the reason it is here and, where it is
debt rather than design, the fix that removes it.
Generated 2026-08-19 from ground truth, after classifying per site rather than sweeping:
the raw run reported 27 policy findings and 33 org_id findings. Three legitimate idempotency
patterns accounted for 21 of the policy findings and are now recognised by the check itself,
not baselined — burying a valid pattern in a baseline is how a check earns a 60%
false-positive rate and then stops meaning anything.
_policies_comment: REAL DEBT, not design. Each is a consolidation: the migration DROPs the OLD policy names and
CREATEs a NEW name that was never dropped. First run succeeds; a RE-RUN aborts at the CREATE
and silently leaves everything below it unapplied. Fix for every one is identical and safe —
add `DROP POLICY IF EXISTS <new name> ON <table>;` immediately before the CREATE. Not applied
here because it edits RLS DDL, which CLAUDE.md requires be flagged rather than done silently.

policies.007_enhancements.sql: comm_log_org_selec: consolidation, new name never dropped — re-run aborts
policies.007_enhancements.sql: comm_prefs_org@com: consolidation, new name never dropped — re-run aborts
policies.009_security.sql: comm_log_read@communic: §A merges 3 policies into 1; drops the 3 old names, creates a 4th — re-run aborts

_orgIdTables_comment: Tables with no org_id that are NOT identity-scoped. The identity-scoped three
(user_passkeys, passkey_challenges, passkey_aal_grants) are NOT here — they resolve through
.claude/rules/identity-scoped-tables.md, which is the single source for that exception.
Most below are design, not debt: platform-global reference data, pre-signup capture, or
self-scoped rows where the table IS the org boundary.

orgIdTables.organisations: the org itself — it IS the boundary, an org_id would be its own id
orgIdTables.user_profiles: self-scoped to a user, read before org selection
orgIdTables.waitlist: pre-signup capture, no org exists yet
orgIdTables.contact_leads: pre-signup marketing capture, no org exists yet
orgIdTables.lease_clause_library: platform-provided clause catalogue, shared across orgs
orgIdTables.prime_rates: public SA reference data, read-only, deliberately global
orgIdTables.application_tokens: token row keyed by its own secret; scoped via the application it points at
orgIdTables.property_info_request_events: public-form telemetry, no authenticated org context
orgIdTables.consent_verification_rate_limits: rate-limit bucket keyed by identifier, pre-auth
orgIdTables.device_fingerprints: bound to a user/session, read before org selection
orgIdTables.step_up_challenges: transient auth ceremony for a user, pre-org
orgIdTables.feedback_replies: child of feedback; scoped through its parent
orgIdTables.login_rate_limits: rate-limit bucket keyed by identifier, pre-auth
orgIdTables.user_template_favourites: self-scoped to a user across orgs by design
orgIdTables.whatsapp_cs_windows: keyed by phone number, spans orgs by nature of the channel
orgIdTables.document_template_versions: child of document_templates; scoped through its parent
orgIdTables.property_insurance_checklist_events: child of a property-scoped row; scoped through its parent
